_comment: sim-arm-reactive-replan-v1 hand-off fragment. PR-A wires the ported humangate decision core onto the vendored scripts/twin/humans evaluator as the SINGLE human motion authority over the free-space arm legs (RUN/SLOW/STOP/BACKSTOP, fail-toward-stop). PR-B adds the execution-time corridor-watch preempt + cuMotion re-plan against the merged perceived-clearance seams (esdf_source/collision_gate/gated_motion). Opt-in HOST keys, byte-identical when absent/false. Merge the keys below into the mission HOST config (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> TransferController; config_preflight registers them HOST). The Isaac side wires the detection provider + the arm-pause sink + the ESDF clearance source at boot behind humans.enabled / perception_collision_gate (see _isaac_wiring). The integration lane holds the GPU and schedules bounded proof runs through /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never forced, never touching whispr; do NOT edit the ~/datasets runtime configs from a worker PR.
_reactive_arm_human_note: HOST bool. Enables the human-aware RUN/SLOW/STOP/BACKSTOP authority over the free-space re-plannable arm legs (approach/lift/retreat + staged tuck/pan/retreat_tuck/stow). Absent/false => the ReactiveArmSupervisor is never constructed and TransferController.step skips the seam => byte-identical. The nvblox map is NEVER the stop (scout sim-perception-architecture-s1 §4): this gate owns it; people are generic dynamic volumes for routing only (PR-B).
_reactive_arm_note: HOST dict (optional tuning; absent => conservative defaults). All SIM-clock (freshness-sim-clock-not-wall): state_max_age_s/heartbeat_timeout_s bound the safety frame's sim-age, which render pacing only makes more generous in wall time. clear_dwell_s = the self-observed healthy-CLEAR a RESUME needs (defence in depth over the camera dwell). require_initial_dwell=false (default) => a mission that has never been restricted runs from tick one (humans.reaction clean-start semantics); the dwell gates only release from a SLOW/STOP/BACKSTOP restriction. The 'backstop' sub-dict tunes the independent watcher (ArmBackstopParams); the 'replan' sub-dict (PR-B) tunes the corridor watch. Fields map 1:1 to ArmGateConfig / ArmBackstopParams / ReactiveReplanController + PerceptionCollisionGate.
_perception_collision_gate_note: SIBLING sim-rgbd-arm-collision-aware-v1 HOST key. REQUIRED for PR-B: it wraps the motion port in a GatedMotionPort that exposes the live nvblox esdf_source + leg_corridor the execution-time corridor watch consumes. With it OFF the corridor watch has no ESDF source and stays inert (logged 'REACTIVE_REPLAN enabled but perception_collision_gate is OFF'). See docs/examples/rgbd-arm-collision-fragment.json.
_reactive_arm_replan_note: HOST bool (PR-B). Enables the EXECUTION-TIME corridor watch: while a free-space re-plannable leg executes, re-query the live ESDF along the gripper(+carton) swept corridor of the REMAINING leg; a NEW obstacle below margin preempts (e-stop-free motion.cancel) + re-plans the remaining leg against the current ESDF (routes around it), bounded by reactive_arm.replan.max_replans then a self-recovering HOLD. Only a FINITE observed clearance below margin counts as an intrusion (an unobserved/stale corridor is the dispatch gate's concern). The watch tuning lives under reactive_arm.replan (below). Absent/false => inert => byte-identical.

_keys_per_file.arm_human_gate.py: [PR-A] ArmHumanGate + ArmGateConfig + ArmSafetyFrame + frame_from_safety_state -- the ported humangate decision core (RUN/SLOW/STOP/BACKSTOP, fail-toward-stop, resume dwell, lost-close refusal, STOP->BACKSTOP fall-through).
_keys_per_file.arm_backstop.py: [PR-A] ArmBackstopWatcher + ArmBackstopParams -- the ported independent cancel watcher (latches).
_keys_per_file.reactive_replan.py: [PR-B] ReactiveReplanController -- the pure execution-time re-plan decide core (continue/preempt/bounded/self-recovering HOLD, rate-limited; ported dynamic_pick shape).
_keys_per_file.reactive_arm.py: ReactiveArmSupervisor -- the single controller seam; e-stop-free motion.cancel()/cancel_outcome() preempt + ArmCommandGate.set_paused (PR-A) + _corridor_watch reusing collision_gate.evaluate_corridor + esdf_source, and build_corridor_fn() (PR-B).
_keys_per_file.controller.py: reactive_arm_human/reactive_arm/reactive_arm_replan kwargs; set_human_detection_provider()/set_arm_pause_sink()/set_arm_clearance_source(); the step() seam (measured/goal/held) + the slow= OR at the in-scope issue sites; per-op reset in start().
_keys_per_file.native_transport.py: [PR-A] ArmCommandGate.set_paused(bool) -- reversible, non-latching human-safety freeze (distinct from hold()/faulted); watchdog + command drop while paused.
_keys_per_file.ros_host.py / ros_host_config.json / con: read + register the HOST keys (reactive_arm_human, reactive_arm, reactive_arm_replan) + wire the PR-B ESDF source from the GatedMotionPort (byte-identical when off).

_isaac_wiring: At boot, behind humans.enabled: controller.set_human_detection_provider(provider) where provider(now_wall)->humans.perception.messages.SafetyState|None (ground-truth or detector-fed), and controller.set_arm_pause_sink(arm_gate.set_paused). With no sink wired, the e-stop-free cancel-hold is the sole stop (still safe). PR-B: ros_host wires controller.set_arm_clearance_source(esdf_source, corridor_fn) from reactive_arm.build_corridor_fn(motion) when the motion port is the sibling GatedMotionPort (perception_collision_gate on) -- the same live nvblox ESDF cuMotion plans against.

_gpu_proof_S4._status: PENDING -- bounded GPU run, integration-lane-owned, after coldwin63 + the perception-lane session release /tmp/aile-gpu.lock. HEAVY_MB=2500, renice +10, <=20 min, never --force.
_gpu_proof_S4._command: scripts/run_mobile_restock.py ... (collect carry leg) with the HOST keys above + humans.enabled and a scripted person crossing the arm's reach on the vendored humans path (detection.source ground_truth for the bench).
_gpu_proof_S4._acceptance: (1) PR-B obstacle: a person or sliding carton crosses the arm's REMAINING swept corridor on a free-space carry leg -- the console shows REACTIVE_ARM_PREEMPT action=REPLAN, the arm cancels (e-stop-free, no /manipulation/stop), re-plans the remaining leg against the current ESDF (routes around the obstacle) and COMPLETES without contact; bounded by max_replans then a self-recovering HOLD. (2) PR-A person: a person entering reach drives the gate CLEAR->SLOW->STOP -- REACTIVE_ARM_HOLD action=SLOW then STOP, the arm PAUSES (set_paused True; no CARTON_TILT since the welded carton holds its level pose), and after the person leaves THROUGH the SLOW ring (tracked departure) + the clear dwell the arm RESUMES (set_paused False, re-plan from the live pose). No global /manipulation/stop (no host e-stop) in either. Record VRAM peak + re-plan latency. The box stays parallel to the ground (2.0 deg / 0.15 s, never loosened) throughout -- the carton-level gate is unchanged and runs before this seam each tick.
_gpu_proof_S4._measured_latencies: TBD on the S4 run (gate decide latency; cancel->settle ticks; cuMotion re-plan latency; resume dwell). CPU bench numbers below stand in until then.

_cpu_proof: PR-A: scripts/twin/tests/test_reactive_arm_human.py -- ported gate scenarios, the supervisor driven by a scripted person distance (preempt + pause + resume), the REAL TransferController.step seam, ArmCommandGate.set_paused. PR-B: scripts/twin/tests/test_reactive_arm_replan.py -- the ReactiveReplanController (continue/preempt/bounded/HOLD/reset); the supervisor corridor watch against a MOCK nvblox ESDF (AnalyticBoxEsdfSource, moving obstacle) + the REAL PerceptionCollisionGate (obstacle enters the corridor -> preempt + re-plan -> continue; persistent obstacle -> bounded re-plans -> self-recovering HOLD); the real controller seam; a moving-obstacle timeline replay. Run: env -u PYTHONPATH PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest scripts/twin/tests/test_reactive_arm_human.py scripts/twin/tests/test_reactive_arm_replan.py -q
_activation_check: config_preflight --require reactive_arm_human (and/or reactive_arm_replan) asserts the key is present in the HOST config (not mis-filed into the runtime config -- the run-277 trap). reactive_arm_replan ALSO needs perception_collision_gate on (the ESDF source); ros_host logs 'REACTIVE_REPLAN wired ...' vs 'enabled but perception_collision_gate is OFF ... inert'.
